spans.s:
mfn. (-यत्-यती-यत्)
Reflecting, considering.
E.
चिति to think, and शतृ aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be considered or thought.
2 To be comprehended.
3 To be meditated on.
E.
चिति to reflect, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be considered, to be reflected on.
E.
चिति to think, (10th cl.) तव्य aff.

ind.
Having thought or considered.
E.
चिति to think, (10th cl.) क्त्वा aff.

f. (-न्ता)
Reflexion, consideration, recollection.
E.
चिति to reflect, affixes अङ् and ठाप्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Disturbed in thought or distracted by any idea.
E.
चिन्ता, and आकुल agitated.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Thoughtful, anxious.
E.
चिन्ता, and पर engaged in.

m. (-णिः)
1 A fabulous gem, supposed to yield its possessor whatever may be required.
2 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
3

A Jina or Jaina saint.
E.
त्रिन्ता reflexion, and मणि a jewel.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Reflecting, considering, meditating.
E.
चिति to think, शानच aff.

mfn. (-बान्-वती-वत्)
Thinking, thoughtful.
E.
चिन्ता, and मतुप् aff.

n. (-श्म)
Council house or room.
E.
चिन्ता reflexion, and वेश्मन् a house.

f. (-डी)
The tamarind tree.
E.
irregularly changed from तिन्तिडी, q. v. also चिन्तिडीका, कन् being added.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Thought, considered.
2 Reflecting, considering.
n. (-तं)
Reflexion: see चिन्ता.
E.
चिति to think, affix क्त.

f. (-तिः)
Consideration, reflexion.
E.
चिति to think, क्तिन् aff.

f. (-या)
Reflexion, consideration, thinking.
E.
चिति, and इय aff.

f. (-क्तिः)
Midnight cry or alarm.

mfn. (-न्त्यः-न्त्या-न्त्यं)
1 To be considered.
2 To be appreciated or conceived.
3 To be thought of or meditated upon.
E.
चित् to think, यत् aff.

m. (-न्नः)
A kind of grain, (Panicum miliaceum,) a various reading of चीन, q. v.

m. (-नः)
1 A kind of deer.
2 A sort of panic, (Panicum miliaceum.)
3 A country,

China.
4

A sort of cloth.
5 A thread.
n. (-नं)
1 A banner, (perhaps made of deer skin.)
2 Lead.
E.
चि to collect, नक् affix, and the deriv. irr.

mfn. (-न्वन्-न्वन्ती-न्वत्)
Gathering, collecting.
E.
चि to gather, (5th cl.) शतृ aff.

m. (-कः)
A sort of panic, (P. miliaceum.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-रः)
Camphor.
E.
चीन, and कर्पूर the same; the best is from China.

n. (-जं)
Steel.
E.
चीन, and ज produced.

m. (-ष्ठः)
1 Minium or red-lead.
2 Lead.
E.
चीन China, and पिष्ठ cake; brought in lumps from the hills on the northwest of Bengal, and between it and China.

n. (-ङ्गं)
Lead, or more probably tutenague.
E.
चीन, and वङ्ग zinc.

n. (-कं)
China cloth, silk.
E.
चीन, and अंशुक cloth.
